```{r}
# Helper function
pick_col <- function(dt, candidates, label = "column", required = TRUE) {
  hits <- candidates[candidates %in% colnames(dt)]
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    if (required) {
      stop(
        "Could not find ", label, ". Checked: ",
        paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
      )
    } else {
      return(NA_character_)
    }
  }
  hits[1]
}

clean_gene <- function(x) {
  toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
}

clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- toupper(x)

  # Standardize RNA-style IDs:
  # TP03.117  -> TP03-117
  # TP15.M509 -> TP15-M509
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)

  # Remove tumor/normal suffixes
  # TP03-117_T  -> TP03-117
  # TP03-117T   -> TP03-117
  # TP03-117NL  -> TP03-117
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("T$", "", x)

  x <- sub("_N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-N$", "", x)
  x <- sub("NL$", "", x)

  # Normalize numeric IDs with leading zero after dash:
  # TP09-09 -> TP09-9
  x <- sub("^(TP[0-9]+)-0+([0-9]+)$", "\\1-\\2", x)

  x
}

collapse_duplicate_rows_numeric <- function(mat) {
  if (is.null(rownames(mat))) {
    stop("Matrix must have row names before collapsing duplicate rows.")
  }

  if (!anyDuplicated(rownames(mat))) {
    return(mat)
  }

  feature_ids <- unique(rownames(mat))

  out <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(feature_ids, function(feature_id) {
      idx <- which(rownames(mat) == feature_id)
      colMeans(mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  )

  rownames(out) <- feature_ids
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)

  out
}

collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric <- function(mat) {
  if (is.null(colnames(mat))) {
    stop("Matrix must have column names before collapsing duplicate columns.")
  }

  if (!anyDuplicated(colnames(mat))) {
    return(mat)
  }

  sample_ids <- unique(colnames(mat))

  out <- do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(sample_ids, function(sample_id) {
      idx <- which(colnames(mat) == sample_id)
      rowMeans(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  )

  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- sample_ids

  out
}

drop_zero_variance_features <- function(mat) {
  keep <- apply(mat, 1, function(z) {
    z <- z[is.finite(z)]
    length(unique(z)) > 1
  })

  mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

make_binary_gene_sample_matrix <- function(events_dt, all_samples, min_mutated_samples = 2) {
  if (nrow(events_dt) == 0) {
    return(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(all_samples)))
  }

  events_dt <- unique(events_dt[, .(feature, sample)])

  recurrent_features <- events_dt[
    ,
    .(n_mutated_samples = uniqueN(sample)),
    by = feature
  ][
    n_mutated_samples >= min_mutated_samples,
    feature
  ]

  if (length(recurrent_features) == 0) {
    return(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(all_samples)))
  }

  mat <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = length(recurrent_features),
    ncol = length(all_samples),
    dimnames = list(sort(recurrent_features), sort(all_samples))
  )

  fill_dt <- events_dt[feature %in% recurrent_features]
  mat[cbind(fill_dt$feature, fill_dt$sample)] <- 1

  mat <- drop_zero_variance_features(mat)

  mat
}

cnv_to_numeric <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))

  need_parse <- is.na(out)

  out[need_parse & grepl("HOMDEL|HOMODEL|HOMOZYGOUS.*DEL|DEEP.*DEL|HD", x_chr)] <- -2
  out[need_parse & grepl("HETDEL|HETEROZYGOUS.*DEL|SHALLOW.*DEL|LOSS|DEL", x_chr)] <- -1
  out[need_parse & grepl("AMP|AMPLIFICATION", x_chr)] <- 2
  out[need_parse & grepl("GAIN|DUP", x_chr)] <- 1
  out[need_parse & grepl("NEUTRAL|DIPLOID|NONE|NO[_ ]?CALL|WT", x_chr)] <- 0

  out
}

matrix_to_long <- function(mat, view_name) {
  dt <- as.data.table(as.table(mat))
  setnames(dt, c("feature", "sample", "value"))

  dt[
    ,
    `:=`(
      sample = as.character(sample),
      feature = as.character(feature),
      view = view_name,
      value = as.numeric(value)
    )
  ]

  dt[is.finite(value), .(sample, feature, view, value)]
}
```

```{r}
# Load OncoKB cancer gene list
oncokb_dt <- fread(ONCOKB_GENE_FILE)

oncokb_gene_col <- pick_col(
  oncokb_dt,
  c("Hugo Symbol", "Hugo_Symbol", "Hugo.Symbol", "Gene", "gene"),
  label = "OncoKB gene symbol column"
)

oncokb_type_col <- pick_col(
  oncokb_dt,
  c("Gene Type", "Gene_Type", "Gene.Type", "gene_type"),
  label = "OncoKB gene type column"
)

oncokb_dt[
  ,
  Gene_clean := clean_gene(get(oncokb_gene_col))
]

oncokb_dt[
  ,
  Gene_Type_clean := toupper(trimws(as.character(get(oncokb_type_col))))
]

oncokb_driver_genes <- oncokb_dt[
  grepl("ONCOGENE|TSG", Gene_Type_clean),
  unique(Gene_clean)
]

length(oncokb_driver_genes)
head(oncokb_driver_genes)
```

```{r}
# Prepare RNA-seq view for MOFA2 ((data already VST-normalized))
# Select top 5000 most variable genes
rna_obj <- readRDS(RNA_VST_FILE)

if (is.data.frame(rna_obj)) {
  rna_dt <- as.data.table(rna_obj)

  possible_gene_col <- pick_col(
    rna_dt,
    c("gene", "Gene", "Hugo_Symbol", "hgnc_symbol", "symbol", "ensembl_gene_id"),
    label = "RNA feature column",
    required = FALSE
  )

  if (!is.na(possible_gene_col)) {
    rna_features <- rna_dt[[possible_gene_col]]
    rna_dt[, (possible_gene_col) := NULL]
    rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_dt)
    rownames(rna_mat) <- rna_features
  } else {
    rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_obj)
  }
} else {
  rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_obj)
}

if (is.null(rownames(rna_mat))) {
  stop("RNA VST matrix must have feature names as row names.")
}

if (is.null(colnames(rna_mat))) {
  stop("RNA VST matrix must have sample names as column names.")
}

storage.mode(rna_mat) <- "numeric"

rownames(rna_mat) <- trimws(as.character(rownames(rna_mat)))
colnames(rna_mat) <- clean_sample_id(colnames(rna_mat))

rna_mat <- collapse_duplicate_rows_numeric(rna_mat)
rna_mat <- collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric(rna_mat)

rna_mat <- rna_mat[apply(rna_mat, 1, function(z) any(is.finite(z))), , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(rna_mat) > TOP_N_RNA_GENES) {
  rna_var <- apply(rna_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  rna_keep <- names(sort(rna_var, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(TOP_N_RNA_GENES)]
  rna_mat <- rna_mat[rna_keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

rna_mat <- drop_zero_variance_features(rna_mat)

dim(rna_mat)
```
```{r}
# Prepare somatic mutation view for MOFA2
# The WES mutation file is a MAF file with:
# Hugo_Symbol, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Variant_Classification, FILTER, etc.
# The WES mutation (tier-1 variant) view is restricted to OncoKB ONCOGENE or TSG genes
# MIN_MUTATED_SAMPLES <- 2
# Build binary gene-level mutation matrix (1 = mutated)

wes_maf <- fread(WES_MAF_FILE)

required_wes_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_wes_cols <- setdiff(required_wes_cols, colnames(wes_maf))

if (length(missing_wes_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in WES MAF file: ",
    paste(missing_wes_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

wes_maf[
  ,
  `:=`(
    sample = clean_sample_id(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    feature = clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol),
    variant_class = trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification))
  )
]

# Keep only PASS variants if FILTER column is available.
if ("FILTER" %in% colnames(wes_maf)) {
  wes_maf <- wes_maf[
    is.na(FILTER) | FILTER == "" | toupper(trimws(as.character(FILTER))) == "PASS"
  ]
}

# Keep protein-altering / likely functional mutation classes.
wes_keep_classes <- c(
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

wes_maf <- wes_maf[
  variant_class %in% wes_keep_classes
]

wes_all_samples <- sort(unique(wes_maf$sample))

wes_mut_events <- wes_maf[
  feature %in% oncokb_driver_genes,
  .(feature, sample)
]

wes_mut_mat <- make_binary_gene_sample_matrix(
  events_dt = wes_mut_events,
  all_samples = wes_all_samples,
  min_mutated_samples = MIN_MUTATED_SAMPLES
)

dim(wes_mut_mat)

wes_mut_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Total WES mutation rows after PASS and functional-class filtering",
    "Unique WES tumor samples",
    "Unique OncoKB oncogene/TSG mutated genes before recurrence filter",
    "Recurrent WES mutated genes retained",
    "Samples in final WES mutation matrix"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(wes_maf),
    length(wes_all_samples),
    uniqueN(wes_mut_events$feature),
    nrow(wes_mut_mat),
    ncol(wes_mut_mat)
  )
)

wes_mut_summary

fwrite(
  wes_mut_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "WES_mutation_recurrent_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```
```{r}
# Prepare WES CNV numeric view
# The WES CNV file has one CNV call per gene per sample:
# Sample, SYMBOL, VARIANT_CLASS
#
# CNV coding:
# Homdel = -2
# Hetdel = -1
# Neutral = 0
# Gain = 1
# Amplification = 2
#
# Only OncoKB ONCOGENE or TSG genes are retained.

wes_cnv <- fread(WES_CNV_FILE)

required_cnv_cols <- c("Sample", "SYMBOL", "VARIANT_CLASS")

missing_cnv_cols <- setdiff(required_cnv_cols, colnames(wes_cnv))

if (length(missing_cnv_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in WES CNV file: ",
    paste(missing_cnv_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

wes_cnv[
  ,
  `:=`(
    sample = clean_sample_id(Sample),
    feature = clean_gene(SYMBOL),
    cnv_call = toupper(trimws(as.character(VARIANT_CLASS)))
  )
]

wes_cnv[
  ,
  cnv_value := fifelse(
    grepl("HOMDEL|HOMODEL|HOMOZYGOUS.*DEL|DEEP.*DEL", cnv_call), -2,
    fifelse(
      grepl("HETDEL|HETEROZYGOUS.*DEL|SHALLOW.*DEL|LOSS|DEL", cnv_call), -1,
      fifelse(
        grepl("AMP|AMPLIFICATION", cnv_call), 2,
        fifelse(
          grepl("GAIN|DUP", cnv_call), 1,
          fifelse(
            grepl("NEUTRAL|DIPLOID|NONE|NO[_ ]?CALL|WT", cnv_call), 0,
            NA_real_
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
]

wes_cnv_long <- wes_cnv[
  feature %in% oncokb_driver_genes & is.finite(cnv_value),
  .(feature, sample, value = cnv_value)
]

# In case any gene-sample pair appears more than once, keep the strongest CNV call.
# Example: HomDel (-2) is stronger than HetDel (-1); Amp (2) is stronger than Gain (1).
wes_cnv_long <- wes_cnv_long[
  ,
  .(value = value[which.max(abs(value))[1]]),
  by = .(feature, sample)
]

wes_cnv_wide <- dcast(
  wes_cnv_long,
  feature ~ sample,
  value.var = "value",
  fill = 0
)

wes_cnv_mat <- as.matrix(wes_cnv_wide[, -"feature"])
rownames(wes_cnv_mat) <- wes_cnv_wide$feature
storage.mode(wes_cnv_mat) <- "numeric"

wes_cnv_mat <- collapse_duplicate_rows_numeric(wes_cnv_mat)
wes_cnv_mat <- collapse_duplicate_cols_numeric(wes_cnv_mat)
wes_cnv_mat <- drop_zero_variance_features(wes_cnv_mat)

dim(wes_cnv_mat)

# Each value is counted across all gene × sample cells after converting CNV calls into numbers
wes_cnv_summary <- data.table(
  CNV_value = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
  Interpretation = c(
    "Homozygous deletion",
    "Heterozygous deletion / loss",
    "No CNV alteration",
    "Gain",
    "Amplification"
  ),
  N_values = c(
    sum(wes_cnv_mat == -2, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(wes_cnv_mat == -1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(wes_cnv_mat == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(wes_cnv_mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(wes_cnv_mat == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

wes_cnv_summary

fwrite(
  wes_cnv_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "WES_CNV_numeric_encoding_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

wes_cnv_altered_gene_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Total unique OncoKB CNV genes retained",
    "Unique genes with HomDel",
    "Unique genes with HetDel/loss",
    "Unique genes with Gain",
    "Unique genes with Amplification",
    "Unique genes with any CNV alteration"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(wes_cnv_mat),
    sum(rowSums(wes_cnv_mat == -2, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(wes_cnv_mat == -1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(wes_cnv_mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(wes_cnv_mat == 2, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
    sum(rowSums(wes_cnv_mat != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  )
)

wes_cnv_altered_gene_summary
```
```{r}
# Prepare IMPACT mutation view

# The IMPACT mutation file contains:
# TUMOR_SAMPLE, NORMAL_SAMPLE, SYMBOL, Variant_Classification, etc.
#
# The IMPACT mutation view is restricted to:
# 1. Protein-altering / likely functional mutation classes
# 2. OncoKB ONCOGENE or TSG genes
#
# No recurrence filter is applied to IMPACT because this is a targeted
# deep-sequencing cancer gene panel with a limited number of cancer-associated genes.

impact_dt_raw <- fread(IMPACT_FILE)

required_impact_cols <- c("TUMOR_SAMPLE", "SYMBOL", "Variant_Classification")

missing_impact_cols <- setdiff(required_impact_cols, colnames(impact_dt_raw))

if (length(missing_impact_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in IMPACT file: ",
    paste(missing_impact_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

impact_dt_raw[
  ,
  `:=`(
    sample = clean_sample_id(TUMOR_SAMPLE),
    feature = clean_gene(SYMBOL),
    variant_class = trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification))
  )
]

# Keep all IMPACT tumor samples before filtering variants.
# This preserves samples even if they have no retained OncoKB functional mutation.
impact_all_samples <- sort(unique(impact_dt_raw$sample))

# Keep protein-altering / likely functional mutation classes.
# This removes UTR, intronic, silent, and other non-coding/non-functional calls.
impact_keep_classes <- c(
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

impact_dt <- impact_dt_raw[
  variant_class %in% impact_keep_classes
]

impact_mut_events <- unique(
  impact_dt[
    feature %in% oncokb_driver_genes,
    .(feature, sample)
  ]
)

impact_genes_keep <- sort(unique(impact_mut_events$feature))

impact_mut_mat <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(impact_genes_keep),
  ncol = length(impact_all_samples),
  dimnames = list(impact_genes_keep, impact_all_samples)
)

if (nrow(impact_mut_events) > 0) {
  impact_mut_mat[
    cbind(impact_mut_events$feature, impact_mut_events$sample)
  ] <- 1
}

# Remove any genes with no mutation after filtering, if present.
impact_mut_mat <- impact_mut_mat[
  rowSums(impact_mut_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dim(impact_mut_mat)

impact_mut_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c(
    "Total IMPACT mutation rows before filtering",
    "Total IMPACT mutation rows after functional-class filtering",
    "Unique IMPACT tumor samples",
    "Unique OncoKB oncogene/TSG mutated genes retained",
    "Unique OncoKB oncogene/TSG mutation events retained",
    "Samples in final IMPACT mutation matrix",
    "Recurrence filter applied"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(impact_dt_raw),
    nrow(impact_dt),
    length(impact_all_samples),
    uniqueN(impact_mut_events$feature),
    nrow(impact_mut_events),
    ncol(impact_mut_mat),
    "No"
  )
)

impact_mut_summary

fwrite(
  impact_mut_summary,
  file.path(TABLE_DIR, "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```

```{r}
# Print dimensions of each saved view
lapply(view_mats, dim)
```
